Reducing abuse of tobacco, alcohol, and drugs
Decisions about the use of tobacco, alcohol, and
other drugs are among the most important health-
related choices that individuals can make. Because
individual options are limited by the strongly ad-
dictive character of these substances, and because
addiction is often established in adolescence, deci-
sions about the control of tobacco and other addic-
tive substances are among the most important
health-related choices that societies can make col-
